answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 164870 Country: SAUDI ARABIA Title: I want to clear some confusions regarding my earnings from my service Question: I am an IT consultant working on Banking Application. I am working in IT company giving services to Bank, where I am responsible for the Server/Application of Issuing Debit Card to customers, maintaining Bank ATM's, Services on the ATM to the customers, also POS (shopping with Debit Card) transactions. Is there any impurity or concern of Halal/Haram in my salary i am getting from my IT company. Answer ID: 164870 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1450/1170/B=01/1440) It you have to write, check or observe interest based dealing in the bank then it is haram and your income is haram. If you have not to deal with interest based task then it is allowable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
